description: Source code for the SX126x LoRa driver for STM32WL microcontrollers, including functions for reset, IRQ handling, and transmission parameter configuration.

methods.name: sx126x_reset
methods.description: Resets the SX126x radio module by toggling the reset line with delays.

methods.name: sx126x_is_busy
methods.description: Checks if the SX126x radio is busy.

methods.name: sx126x_get_dio1_pin_state
methods.description: Returns the state of the DIO1 pin (stub implementation returning 0).

methods.name: sx126x_set_tx_params
methods.description: Configures transmission parameters such as power and ramp time based on amplifier output and maximum power constraints.

methods.name: sx126x_variant_init
methods.description: Initializes the SX126x variant, setting up IRQs and external interrupt lines.
